_meta.task: B6-T1 sample selection — RBI Master-Directions rediscovery benchmark
_meta.status: DRAFT — pending_human_signoff (B6_TASKS §3.1: human sign-off required BEFORE mass download)
_meta.reachability_probe: rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_ViewMasterDirections.aspx fetched once (736 KB, ~58 MDs in one category page) to confirm retrievability; NO source circulars or answer keys downloaded.
_meta.selection_criteria: §1.1: (a) published traceability appendix; (b) ~10-80 source circulars; (c) domain spread; (d) publicly retrievable (rbi.org.in / web.archive.org).
_meta.leakage_note: Naming the MDs here is corpus definition (§1.2), not a proposal-pipeline input. The pipeline never sees MD names; circular ids are pseudonymized (T2).

proposed_sample.title: Master Direction – Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016
proposed_sample.has_traceability_appendix: yes (Repeal & Other Provisions section lists superseded circulars / master circular)
proposed_sample.est_source_circulars: 40-80 (upper end; a size-risk to confirm on acquisition — may need trimming to the core AML/KYC set)
proposed_sample.rationale: The canonical KYC/AML consolidation; large, well-documented repeal list; the domain the engine PRD names first.

proposed_sample.title: Master Direction – Classification, Valuation and Operation of Investment Portfolio of Commercial Banks (Directions), 2023
proposed_sample.has_traceability_appendix: yes (annex of repealed circulars / master circular on investments)
proposed_sample.rationale: A clean prudential consolidation with an explicit repeal annex; mid-size corpus.

proposed_sample.title: Master Direction – Reserve Bank of India (Interest Rate on Deposits) Directions, 2016
proposed_sample.rationale: The deposits/interest-rate domain required by §1.1(c); a 2016-vintage MD with a documented repeal appendix.

proposed_sample.title: Master Direction on Fraud Risk Management in Commercial Banks (including Regional Rural Banks) and All India Financial Institutions, 2024
proposed_sample.has_traceability_appendix: yes (repeals the earlier Master Circular on Frauds + listed circulars)
proposed_sample.rationale: Covers the governance/oversight domain (board & audit-committee fraud responsibilities); a very recent (2024) RRA-style consolidation with a clean repeal list.

proposed_sample.title: Master Direction – Reserve Bank of India (Priority Sector Lending – Targets and Classification) Directions, 2020
proposed_sample.rationale: A second prudential/lending domain; large, well-mapped PSL circular set.

proposed_sample.title: Master Direction – Credit Card and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022
proposed_sample.rationale: Adds a conduct/payments domain; a compact, well-documented 2022 consolidation.

proposed_sample.title: Master Direction on Digital Payment Security Controls, 2021
proposed_sample.has_traceability_appendix: partial (fewer explicit repeals; more a fresh framework) — a size/answer-key RISK to confirm
proposed_sample.rationale: A cyber/IT domain for spread; flagged as a candidate to DROP if its repeal list is too thin to score (§1.1a).

rejected_candidates.candidate: Master Direction – Compounding of Contraventions under FEMA, 1999
rejected_candidates.reason: regulatory-process direction; not a consolidation of prior subject-matter circulars into groupings — no grouping to rediscover.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Master Direction – Rupee Interest Rate Derivatives / Credit Derivatives / Electronic Trading Platforms
rejected_candidates.reason: narrow market-infrastructure MDs; small source-circular sets below the ~10-80 target and far from board-duty domains.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Master Direction – Operational Guidelines for Primary Dealers
rejected_candidates.reason: niche market-participant scope; poor domain spread contribution.

rejected_candidates.candidate: NBFC-facing Master Directions (IT Framework, Auditor's Report, Fraud Risk in NBFCs)
rejected_candidates.reason: different regulated-entity class; excluded to keep the pooled corpus comparable to the bank-facing set (a deliberate comparability choice, not a quality judgment).

rejected_candidates.candidate: Master Direction – Internal Ombudsman for Regulated Entities, 2023
rejected_candidates.reason: consolidates a small number of scheme documents; thin repeal list, weak grouping signal.

pooling_plan: Per §1.2, pool ALL selected MDs' source circulars into one mixed corpus (est. ~150-260 documents at the mid estimates) and hold out every MD's identity, text, structure, and grouping. The engine proposes groupings on the pooled corpus under a prompt that never names Master Directions or the RRA.
sample_bias_transparency: English-only; bank-facing only (NBFC excluded for comparability); 2016-2024 vintage; sizes estimated, to be confirmed on acquisition. A candidate whose repeal appendix proves too thin to score (DPSC risk) is dropped and its circulars removed from BOTH corpus and answer key symmetrically (§1.1).
